setup: Windows, RTX 3070 Laptop GPU, NOLO HOME 1.23.2.0, original mobile cable on the PC with external 5 V / 2 A, sensor covered, camera on right lens. Cable firmware reported by owner as 2 A. Flash was not read or modified in this run.

prior_422.15:26:46.956: huaweicv1pro: Activate HuaWei VR Glass & NOLO Enable IMU:1

verified_session.startup: Before launch PCUI confirmed CV10, original cable, source PC (1), and acknowledged panel wake. Owner clicked Connect in NOLO. Checked that huaweicv1pro was registered, then ran SteamVR/bin/win64/vrstartup.exe.
verified_session.16:34:14.515: NOLO logged Enable IMU:1; active HMD huaweicv1pro.disco.
verified_session.16:34:18.028: NVIDIA offered 3200x1600 at 90 and 70 Hz, selected 90 Hz.
verified_session.16:37:49.353: Right lens shows the welcome to SteamVR dashboard. No test color overlay in this frame.
verified_session.standby_example: At 16:36:51.194 SteamVR left standby on client connection. At 16:36:56.203 it entered standby again and the camera went black.

usb_pose_before_replug: XHC1 CV10 hub. Port 1 audio 12d1:1092 and port 5 2109:8888 connected; port 2 control 12d1:107e absent at 16:37:46.551. OpenVR reported connected and valid with a constant identity rotation. This does not establish physical head tracking.

first_glasses_end_reconnect.physical_action: Operator turned headset and returned it to the camera. Dashboard remained lit after settling. The individual clockwise and counterclockwise movements were not time-marked.

software_restart.procedure: No foreground scene app. Closed SteamVR normally, left NOLO and cable in place, waited for graceful exit; ran vrstartup.exe again. No driver or SteamVR settings edited.
software_restart.before_restart: Windows and NVIDIA both exposed CV10 EDID HWV0003 after exit, native signal 3200x1600/90; USB control was absent.
software_restart.observed_limitation: 16:51:57 NVIDIA logged Invalid refresh: 0 and WaitForPresent failed. Reinserting only the glasses restored USB at 16:54:08.850 and nonconstant poses, but the camera remained dark in this session even during a dashboard wake. PCUI acknowledged panel wake at 16:54:51.152.
software_restart.recovery: Exited this session normally; vrserver logged graceful exit at 16:57:49.401.

launcher_test.before_launch: At 16:58:00 Windows and NVIDIA exposed HWV0003, native 3200x1600/90; COM24/25 returned CV10 and PC source. No additional physical change.
launcher_test.startup: tools/start-cv10-steamvr.ps1 started SteamVR with NOLO still registered.
launcher_test.16:58:20.168: NVIDIA reported current headset frequency 90 Hz.
launcher_test.16:58:20.686: First hub sample with port 2 disconnected (0.518 s after NVIDIA frequency log; timing alone does not establish a cause).
launcher_test.16:58:22.814: Camera luminance rose; subsequent frames showed the SteamVR scene.

last_glasses_end_reconnect.wiring: Operator reinserted only glasses end, turned the glasses and returned them to the camera. Original 5 V and PC connection intact; same SteamVR process.
last_glasses_end_reconnect.pose: OpenVR returned varying rotations during the user action, activity UserInteraction at 17:01:06.677. After coming to rest SteamVR entered standby.

compositor_awake.stimulus: Opening an OpenVR overlay client woke SteamVR from standby. No power settings changed.
